name: Speed Cursor (Dynamic Size, Fire Halo, Comet & Click Ripple)
description: Never lose your mouse pointer again! Smoothly enlarges the cursor when moving (and scales it bigger with speed), with a Fire-Breathing Halo of Light, a Comet-Fire motion trail, and an On-Click Ripple animation for screen recordings and tutorials. Includes 5 flame color themes, button-coded click rings, Quick Settings toggles, and full customization.
